title: Learning Auditable Classifier Models: Source-Disjoint Tree Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2608.15725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive models in clinical and regulated settings must be accurate and fully auditable. Tree ensembles deliver strong accuracy on tabular data, but their sequential boosting couples structure discovery with coefficient estimation, making compact per-prediction auditing difficult. Interpretable alternatives impose structural constraints that limit expressiveness: generalized additive models typically restrict interactions to pairwise terms and post-hoc rule extractors produce overlapping rules that hinder compact interpretation. We introduce Residual Pattern Tree Ensemble (RPTE), a three-stage learning approach, that is built on three key principles: bounded feature budget, source disjointness, and separate coefficient estimation. Stage~1 builds a supervised symbolic feature vocabulary. Stage~2 grows shallow trees under a source-disjointness constraint, where each raw variable is allocated to at most one tree, and retains only the disc

translated_title: 学习可审计的分类器模型：源分离的树集成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15725v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在临床和监管环境中的预测模型必须准确且完全可审计。树集成在表格数据上表现出强大的准确性，但其顺序提升将结构发现与系数估计耦合在一起，使得紧凑的逐预测审计变得困难。可解释的替代方案施加了限制表达能力的结构约束：广义加性模型通常将交互限制为成对项，而事后规则提取器产生重叠规则，妨碍了紧凑解释。我们引入了残差模式树集成（RPTE），一种三阶段学习方法，基于三个关键原则：有界特征预算、源分离性和独立系数估计。第一阶段构建监督符号特征词汇表。第二阶段在源分离约束下生长浅层树，其中每个原始变量被分配至最多一棵树，并仅保留判别性部分。
tldr: 本论文提出了一种基于源分离和独立系数估计的三阶段树集成方法（RPTE），在保持可审计性的同时提升了模型的可解释性和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a three-stage tree ensemble method (RPTE) based on source disjointness and separate coefficient estimation, enhancing interpretability and accuracy while maintaining auditability.
